rows.ja: 提携・事業の売買・終了した契約
競合(相手の資料に記載)

relations.text: Broadcomは前工程の製造の大半を外部ファウンドリーに委託し、TSMCが委託先製造会社の製造ウエハーの約95%を担った
relations.text_en: Broadcom outsources most front-end wafer manufacturing to external foundries; TSMC made about 95% of CM-produced wafers in FY2025

source.label: Broadcom 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: The majority of our front-end wafer manufacturing operations is outsourced to external foundries, including Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (“TSMC”).

relations.text: 2026年度の第3四半期までの累計で、委託先製造会社の製造ウエハーの約95%をTSMCが担った
relations.text_en: TSMC produced about 95% of wafers made by Broadcom’s contract manufacturers in the first three fiscal quarters of FY2026

source.label: Broadcom 10-Q(Q3 2026年度)
source.quote: During the three fiscal quarters ended August 2, 2026, approximately 95% of the wafers manufactured by our CMs were produced by Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Company Limited (“TSMC”).

relations.text: BroadcomはASEを、組立・テストの外部製造委託先の1社として使う
relations.text_en: Broadcom uses ASE as one of its third-party contract manufacturers for assembly and test.

source.label: Broadcom 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We use third-party CMs for a significant majority of our assembly and test operations, including TSMC, Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc., Foxconn Technology Group, Amkor Technology, Inc. and Siliconware Precision Industries Co., Ltd.

relations.text: Amkorは、組立・テストでBroadcomの外部製造委託先の1社を務める
relations.text_en: Amkor is one of Broadcom's third-party contract manufacturers for assembly and test.

source.label: Broadcom 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We use third-party CMs for a significant majority of our assembly and test operations, including TSMC, Advanced Semiconductor Engineering, Inc., Foxconn Technology Group, Amkor Technology, Inc. and Siliconware Precision Industries Co., Ltd.

relations.text: Googleとの長期契約で、Googleの将来世代のカスタムTPUを開発・供給し、次世代AIラック向けにネットワーク等の部品を2031年まで供給する供給保証契約も結んだ
relations.text_en: Entered a Long Term Agreement to develop and supply custom TPUs for Google, plus a Supply Assurance Agreement for networking and other components for Google’s next-gen AI racks through up to 2031

source.label: Broadcom 8-K(2026年4月6日)
source.quote: Broadcom Inc. (“Broadcom”) and Google LLC (“Google”) have entered into a Long Term Agreement for Broadcom to develop and supply custom Tensor Processing Units (“TPUs”) for Google’s future generations of TPUs and a Supply Assurance Agreement for Broadcom to supply networking and other components to be used in Google’s next-generation AI racks through up to 2031.

relations.text: Appleと技術協力を2031年まで拡大し、Apple製品の複数世代向けカスタムASICを開発・供給する長期契約を結んだ
relations.text_en: Agreed with Apple to expand their technology collaboration through 2031, with long-term agreements to develop and supply custom ASIC silicon for multiple generations of Apple products

source.label: Broadcom 8-K(2026年7月6日)
source.quote: Broadcom Inc. (“Broadcom”) and Apple Inc. (“Apple”) have agreed to expand their long-standing technology collaboration through 2031 by entering into new multi-year long-term agreements for Broadcom to develop and supply a range of custom ASIC silicon products for use in multiple generations of Apple products.

relations.text: Aristaはスイッチ用チップを、主要な汎用シリコン供給元のBroadcomに主に頼る
relations.text_en: Arista relies primarily on Broadcom, its predominant merchant silicon vendor, for its switching chips.

source.label: Arista 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In particular, we are primarily reliant upon our predominant merchant silicon vendor, Broadcom, for our switching chips.
source.note: Arista側の記述です。AristaにとってBroadcomは供給元で、Broadcomから見れば顧客です。
source.note_en: Stated from Arista’s side; for Broadcom, Arista is a customer.

relations.text: AristaがBroadcomからVeloCloud事業を2025年6月30日に3億ドルの現金で取得
relations.text_en: Arista completed the acquisition of the VeloCloud business from Broadcom on June 30, 2025 for $300.0 million in cash

source.label: Arista 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: the VeloCloud business ("VeloCloud") from Broadcom
source.note: BroadcomからAristaへの事業売却です。

relations.text: HPEは業界標準ASSPを、Broadcomなど単一の供給元の1社から調達する
relations.text_en: HPE sources industry-standard ASSPs from single-source suppliers such as Broadcom.

source.label: HPE 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In some instances, our single-source suppliers (e.g., Intel and AMD as suppliers of certain x86 processors Broadcom and others for industry standard Application-Specific Standard Product, or NVIDIA for Graphics Processing Units)
source.note: HPE側の記述です。BroadcomはHPEの供給元で、Broadcomから見れば顧客です。
source.note_en: HPE-side description; Broadcom is HPE’s supplier, so HPE is Broadcom’s customer.

relations.text: Broadcomは、インフラ・クラウド管理ソフトでHPEの主な競合の1社として競り合う
relations.text_en: Broadcom is among HPE's primary competitors in infrastructure and cloud management software.

source.label: HPE 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary competitors are other infrastructure and cloud management software technology vendors, such as Broadcom, Cisco Systems Inc., Dell Technologies Inc., IBM, NetApp Inc., Nutanix, and Pure Storage

relations.text: Google、Anthropicと協力を拡大し、Anthropicは2027年から、Broadcom経由で約3.5ギガワットのTPU型AI計算能力を利用する
relations.text_en: Expanded its collaboration with Google and Anthropic; beginning in 2027, Anthropic will access about 3.5 gigawatts of TPU-based AI compute through Broadcom

source.label: Broadcom 8-K(2026年4月6日)
source.quote: Separately, Broadcom, Google and Anthropic PBC (“Anthropic”) have expanded their current strategic collaboration under which Anthropic, beginning in 2027, will access through Broadcom approximately 3.5 gigawatts as part of the multiple gigawatts of next generation TPU-based AI compute capacity committed by Anthropic.
source.note: Anthropicは未上場です。利用量はAnthropicの事業の成否に左右されます。
source.note_en: Anthropic is not listed. Consumption depends on Anthropic’s continued commercial success.

relations.text: Seagateが2024年4月23日付の資産購入契約で、SoCの設計・開発・製造に関する資産をBroadcom子会社に売却した
relations.text_en: Seagate sold its SoC design, development and manufacture assets to a Broadcom subsidiary under an April 23, 2024 asset purchase agreement

source.label: Seagate 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: On April 23, 2024, the Company entered into an Asset Purchase Agreement with Avago Technologies International Sales Pte. Limited (“Purchaser”), a subsidiary of Broadcom Inc., and sold certain intellectual property, equipment and other assets related to the design, development and manufacture of its SoC products to Purchaser.
source.note: 2024年の過去の取引で、相手はBroadcomの子会社です。
source.note_en: A historical (2024) transaction; the counterparty is a Broadcom subsidiary.

relations.text: Broadcomが2023年11月22日にVMwareを買収した後、DellはVMware単体製品を販売していた包括提携契約を終了した
relations.text_en: Dell terminated its Commercial Framework Agreement under which it distributed standalone VMware offerings after Broadcom acquired VMware on November 22, 2023

source.label: Dell 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: On November 22, 2023, VMware was acquired by Broadcom Inc. (“Broadcom”), and subsequently announced changes to its go-to-market approach for VMware offerings that impacted our commercial relationship with VMware.
source.note: この契約は終了しています。Dellは以前に再販したVMware顧客の支援は続けています。
source.note_en: This agreement has ended; Dell still supports previously resold VMware customers.

relations.text: Broadcomは、一部の製品・サービスでCiscoの競合になる
relations.text_en: Broadcom competes with Cisco for some of its products and services.

source.label: Cisco 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our competitors (in each case relative to only some of our products or services) include: Amazon Web Services LLC; Arista Networks, Inc.; Broadcom Inc.;

relations.text: Broadcomはネットワーク製品でNVIDIAの競合相手だ
relations.text_en: Broadcom competes with NVIDIA in networking products.

source.label: NVIDIA 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: networking products consisting of switches, network adapters (including DPUs), and cable solutions (including optical modules) include such as AMD, Arista Networks, Broadcom, Cisco Systems, Inc.,

relations.text: Broadcomは組み込み事業でAMDと競合している
relations.text_en: Broadcom competes with AMD in its Embedded segment.

source.label: AMD 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: and from ASSP vendors such as Broadcom Corporation, Marvell Technology Group, Ltd., Analog Devices,
source.note: 旧社名の「Broadcom Corporation」で記載されています。

relations.text: Intelは、カスタムASIC開発市場でBroadcomと競合する
relations.text_en: Intel competes with Broadcom in the custom ASIC development market.

source.label: Intel 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We also compete with Broadcom in the custom ASICs development market.

relations.text: Marvellと直接競合する企業の1社にBroadcomがある
relations.text_en: Broadcom competes directly with Marvell's businesses.

source.label: Marvell 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Broadcom Inc. (“Broadcom”), Cisco Systems, Inc. (“Cisco”),

relations.text: Broadcomは無線接続製品でQualcommの競合を成す
relations.text_en: Broadcom competes with Qualcomm in wireless connectivity products.

source.label: Qualcomm 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Examples (some of which are strategic partners of ours in other areas) include Broadcom, HiSilicon, MediaTek,

relations.text: Broadcomは、Astera Labsの主な競合の一角を占める
relations.text_en: Broadcom is one of Astera Labs' principal competitors.

source.label: Astera Labs 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors include Broadcom, Inc., Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd., Marvell Technology, Inc.,

relations.text: Broadcomは、Credoの主な競合に入る
relations.text_en: Broadcom is one of Credo's principal competitors.

source.label: Credo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: Our principal competitors with respect to our products include Broadcom Ltd. (Broadcom), 14 Marvell Technology, Inc. (Marvell) and Astera Labs, Inc. (Astera)

relations.text: Cienaはデータセンター事業への拡大に伴い、Broadcomとの競合を見込む
relations.text_en: Ciena expects to compete with Broadcom as it expands into the data center.

source.label: Ciena 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: we will begin to compete with additional competitors, including Marvell Technology Group, Credo Technology Group, and Broadcom.
source.note: 今後競合する見込み、という将来の記載です。
source.note_en: Forward-looking: it expects to begin competing.

relations.text: MACOMは、主な競合の1社であるBroadcomと市場を争う
relations.text_en: Broadcom is one of MACOM's primary competitors.

source.label: MACOM 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: We primarily compete with Analog Devices, Inc. (“ADI”), Broadcom Inc. (“Broadcom”), Credo Technology Group Holding Ltd.

relations.text: Broadcomは汎用半導体でMaxLinearの主な競合となる
relations.text_en: Broadcom is a primary merchant semiconductor competitor of MaxLinear.

source.label: MaxLinear 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our primary merchant semiconductor competitors include Broadcom Inc., Qualcomm Incorporated,

relations.text: Skyworksは、競合先の1社にBroadcomを抱える
relations.text_en: Broadcom is one of Skyworks' competitors.

source.label: Skyworks 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our competitors include Analog Devices, Broadcom, Cirrus Logic,

relations.text: QorvoのCSG事業は主にBroadcomと競合し、ACG事業も同様だ
relations.text_en: Qorvo's CSG segment competes primarily with Broadcom, and so does its ACG segment.

source.label: Qorvo 10-K(2026年度)
source.quote: CSG competes primarily with Broadcom Inc.; Murata Manufacturing Co., Ltd.;

note.en: Only relationships confirmed in official materials are shown. Not investment advice.
